title: Simplify imperative loops with LINQ Where/Select across all files (~28 instances)
description:
## Source
SonarQube static analysis audit (`Data/Pages/audits/ms-sonar-static-analysis-7-26-26.md`)

## Findings
~28 instances across all files where imperative foreach loops with manual filtering/transformation should be simplified with LINQ:

**Select simplifications (8 instances in Razor):** `Admin.razor` (L73, L121, L221, L227, L897), `HealthStats.razor` (L171), `Models.razor` (L65), `Chat.razor` (L1049)

**Where simplifications (9 instances in Razor+Controllers):** `Admin.razor` (L916), `Chat.razor` (L2455, L2561), `Pages.razor` (L585, L1033, L1042), `Tasks.razor` (L970, L1477), `McpController.cs` (L340)

**Services (11 instances):** `CodeSearchService.cs` (L2623, L2828, L2978, L2986), `ChatServices.cs` (L408, L1511, L3262, L3679), `ChatToolCatalog.cs` (L265, L1419), `MemoryGovernanceServices.cs` (L285, L303, L384), `SemanticEmbeddingSearchService.cs` (L445, L467, L856), `SecurityServices.cs` (L43), `PageService.cs` (L279), `MemoryChatAgent.ToolLoop.cs` (L53), `MemorySmithConfigurationPaths.cs` (L22), `MemorySmithRequestGuardMiddleware.cs` (L77), `VarResolver.cs` (L306), `McpAgentToolHandler.cs` (L220)

## Impact
Imperative loops are more verbose and error-prone than declarative LINQ equivalents. Modernizing to LINQ improves readability and reduces nesting.

## Action Required
Replace `foreach`+`if` patterns with `.Where(...)` and manual list-building with `.Select(...).ToList()`. Preserve existing ordering and semantics.

## Effort
~2h25min

## Priority
P2 — Maintainability
